description: This file defines functions to generate dashboard configurations, including dashboards, charts, and number cards, for manufacturing analytics in an ERP system.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Returns a dictionary with dashboards, charts, and number cards data.

methods.name: get_dashboards
methods.description: Returns a list of dashboard configurations for manufacturing.

methods.name: get_charts
methods.description: Returns a list of chart configurations for manufacturing dashboards.

methods.name: get_number_cards
methods.description: Returns a list of number card configurations for manufacturing metrics.
